description: Get All Templates - Retrieve all email templates with optional filtering. Note: boolean filters (starred/archived) are unreliable. Supported filters: folder, type, taskType, search, sortBy, sortType.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return (default: 100, max 100)

search.description: Search query to filter templates by name

skip.description: Number of templates to skip for pagination (default: 0)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_all_templates

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get All Templates
